authorization: User explicitly requested white name link, F1 completion on that edit, and start F2/subitems. Follow previously planned geometry acceptance before formal rig appearance.

checkpoint.notes: Existing favorite-team/default-selection changes preserved; patch adds only latest F1 source differences to existing pushed base. No original approved assets removed.

contract.zone_height: selected source sz_bot/top; prior explicit fallback when unavailable
contract.release: source trajectory_points[0], originating from per-pitch release_pos_x/y/z; never snapped to rubber/mound centre
contract.clock: source progress/time_seconds; exact endpoints, interpolation between source samples, no modified source coordinates
contract.generic_guides: Foot ring plus generic 1.65m height line only, not measured stature or formal player model
contract.handedness: L/R changes only stand-position guide; source path is not mirrored
contract.bat_data: No measured bat-tip/handle timeline; F2.5 must audit coverage. No fake real swing or contact.

renderer_decision.name: Three.js
renderer_decision.engine_install_scope: Only local historical analysis; no global app or Ballpark engine replacement
renderer_decision.load_boundary: PitchReplayChart -> defineAsyncComponent(client) -> onMounted dynamic createReplayScene import
renderer_decision.fallback: Photo-free/player-image-free SVG schematic with DOM data/video links retained
renderer_decision.asset_sources: Original repo-native deterministic primitives; no imported human model, new generated art, unknown-license textures or third-party stadium scan
renderer_decision.asset_inventory: No existing GLB/glTF/FBX/Blend rig found in inspected frontend/assets/output; Blender CLI not detected; formal rigs remain F2.3
renderer_decision.motion_system_scope: F2.2 only spatial geometry; no procedural guide passed off as animated human

lifecycle.render_policy: on demand, RAF coalescing, no idle loop or damping, pixel-ratio cap1.5, no hidden rendering
lifecycle.progress_updates: retains path geometry when only progress changes
lifecycle.cleanup: cancel RAF, disconnect ResizeObserver, remove visibility/key/pointer/context listeners, dispose OrbitControls/world geometry/material/heatmap texture/renderer, lose context, remove owned canvas; late import guarded
lifecycle.meaning: Source implementation and numeric evidence, not measured GPU/browser leak certification

checks: per-pitch source release distinct from ground/rubber
nonuniform-progress interpolation and exact source endpoints
source values unchanged across L/R stand and timeline
100 progress updates retain static path geometry
geometry disposal and lazy import/lifecycle source boundaries

0%/play/slow/seek start at gold source release above/in front of mound; no hand-side mirroring

Game and Personal switching/video/cards, 2D/3D fallback and leave/return/R preserve function; numeric/device release not implied
